title: eugenia media
intro: Eugenia media, commonly known as the Cayenne cherry or Java plum, is a plant species belonging to the Myrtaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, fever, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia media are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents in Eugenia media have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various diseases, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
